description: Mounted display beside Airport Road erected by Vinton County Airport with an interpretive marker giving the type's specifications; the marker states the aircraft came from Rickenbacker Air National Guard Base and is on loan from the National Museum of the USAF; the marker does not carry the serial so 57-0586 rests on compilation sourcing alone; currency evidence is marker photographs dated 15 August 2009 which are seventeen years old and have not been refreshed
